notes.title: A new vehicle has been added to the hobby shop! It's time to bash!
notes.content: [p]New Content:[/p][p]-A brand new vehicle has been added to the hobby shop! Head there now to check out the HMT, a 1/8 scale fully simulated solid axle monster truck meant for serious bashing! This is the first basher class vehicle in the game, purely designed for stunts, jumps, and having fun! It's time to rip some wheelies and backflips![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/7fcff90f8b3a578acaf14ef55f40e3df09e81d35.png"][/img][/p][p]For a fun bashing area to try until free roam mode comes out check out the track Backyard Skatepark Created by Darth k1r1s10us, Share Code: 1738[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/0db047afe8c33a4c81eeca6f9c501bac80dd4bfa.png"][/img][/p][p]-5 monster truck bodies have been added[/p][p]-A new monster truck wheel option has been, which can also be used on other vehicles[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/29a405fed8270b891ef448f3a4d3c1e07169a3e7.png"][/img][/p][p]Changes:[/p][p]-Complete overhaul to replay creation/upload system to drastically improve performance and eliminate hitching, lag, and hangs when uploading replays (especially long ones)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/97edc3a1a3b65a76092cb593eed9fca10d459293.png"][/img][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]-Fixed issue with long (8+ minute) scores potentially failing to be compressed and upload[/p][p]-Added better catching/reporting of ghost upload errors and saving of your time to try again later[/p][p]-Fixed saved time/replay from uploading at the same time as new time if you beat the time of a failed upload[/p][p]-Fixed leaderboard resetting times when opening it even if you havnt gotten a new time[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/59634c311438ca26822d2b2d57656b79275c2b4c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/2ced5d2ca9f79289dba6aa3eaa79336e8c1b7993.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Content month continues with a brand new track venue!
notes.content:
[p][b]New Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand new huge outdoor venue has been added, the Forest Nationals venue! Adding the biggest space in the game yet for creating huge tracks and a fun place to get creative with all the new builder objects!

Check out the first track in the new venue with Share Code: 2268, I'll see you on the HB44 leaderboards![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b651e8c5212e5cec17de61fc21bb18f5c0fc3948.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/a3f123b24312833dc05a2fc7a8e6ee1ce284169f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Direct Input back-end, potentially adding support for even more devices/fixing issues with others[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed "instant input detected" error always showing when binding from the in race pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input binds getting reset if you open rebind menu on accident[/p][/*][*][p]Path editor now zooms depending on edit area size[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed excessive logging related to direct input devices[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Tons of new track editor objects to kick off content month!
notes.content: [p]This month is all about adding new content to the game to spice things up a little, to kick it off here is a whole bunch of new track editor objects along with some important bug fixes![/p][p][/p][p][b]New Content:[/b][/p][p]-Added 3 wall banner objects[/p][p]-Added two barrel objects[/p][p]-Added a fire barrel object, with light! (experimental)[/p][p]-Added 9 tire and tire stack objects[/p][p]-Added 5 wood platforms/bridges[/p][p]-Added 8 metal ramps[/p][p]-Added 3 metal platforms[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/5458493e3afba3de6e2513ef935c02ed4beab978.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][p]-Tweaked lighting and textures[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/8f233309d00b77732fb63ab3d6fdce3790c40896.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Fixed setting a session marker beyond the finish line on a p2p track breaking resets, lap tracking, and various other things[/p][p]-Fixed timer not starting if session marker is set at the end of a p2p track[/p][p]-Fixed acute accent character causing level file corruption if used in track name[/p][p]-Fixed reset and rewind prompts not showing correct buttons if they were bound to something else[/p][p]-Fixed reset prompts not showing after rewinding[/p][p]-Fixed hangar floor collision being too high causing invisible collision if you build too low[/p][p]-Fixed some collisions on ramp objects[/p]

notes.title: Huge Input Update! Adds support for many more devices!
notes.content: [p][b]Input System Overhaul:[/b][/p][p]-Added support for Direct Input devices, massively improving compatibility with transmitters, sim wheels, old joysticks, etc.[/p][p]-More robust calibration for throttle and steering, allowing for all sorts of different devices to perfectly calibrate input for the game, no need to even adjust trims or end points on your transmitters![/p][p]-Added ability to force a specific device when calibrating[/p][p]-Improved detection of inputs when rebinding[/p][p]-Improved and expanded throttle and steering setup wizard to better handle calibration and correctly setting up a variety of different devices[/p][p]-Improved individual quick rebinding for throttle and steering[/p][p]-Detection/ignoring for noisy/bad inputs when rebinding[/p][p]-Fixed issues with input detection when multiple devices were connected[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b9ec155a35e7fd9baacd81a8e986e28c286b60e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Full input rebinding support:[/b][/p][p]-Added ability to rebind every key in the game, both for controller and keyboard independently, and with an extra empty slot for joysticks (transmitters, sim wheels, etc.)[/p][p]-All new input settings menu with improved controller navigation and access to all new input features[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/8e62de52fbcbe3d0a2a82a47a0b36ed1bc945992.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: INJORA's 9th anniversary competition, win real life prizes!
notes.content:
[p]It's INJORA's 9th anniversary and to celebrate we're throwing an in game contest to win some awesome real life prizes, including the real life versions of wheels featured in the game, like this brand new set just added in the newest update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/d2f2d1313e595951ca44b350bc9ec519a46c8533.png"][/img]
For more information on how to enter, rules, etc. join the official discord channel here (I am hoping to expand this beyond discord in the future but right now its the easiest way for me to handle it one place) - [url="https://discord.gg/XSdudfWjga"]https://discord.gg/XSdudfWjga[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/6fc263efbfa88bac5efde683b17ddf0f67fd0176.jpg"][/img]
[b]INJORA 9th anniversary competition![/b][/p][p]-Look for the event under quick race[/p][p]-Compete to win prizes, including real life versions of wheels that are featured in the game![/p][p](more information on how to enter and win in the official discord server, button to join is on the event tab)[/p][p]-Added new INJORA Moduwheels to the game, find them in the hobby shop![/p][p]-Added several new logo decals courtesy of INJORA![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/1239f6a5c37923924c3bebb1ecb5bc4e92acf195.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Fixed random part break noises happening (mostly in the Thrasher)[/p][p]-Fixed base track height not updating correctly when exiting terrain height editor[/p][p]-Fixed camera looking backwards when doing near vertical jumps while flipping[/p]

notes.title: Highly requested new features, new track objects, graphics improvements, & more!
notes.content: [p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now see your online rank while racing without going to the leaderboards, it will update if you get a better time and show the rank for the current vehicle you're in (if leaderboard is set to all it will use your overall best rank in any vehicle instead)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b1dae8190ac488404eb5e381d35b3ad7f0013b58.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to spectate downloaded ghosts, view their racing lines, and slow down time to study their techniques![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/67ca146ce618d94ab21e3c2f886b5c2b06523433.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Objects:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Loops![/p][/*][*][p]2 new platforms with built in edges[/p][/*][*][p]2 pine trees[/p][/*][*][p]Tree stump[/p][/*][*][p]Standard log[/p][/*][*][p]28 new road signs, arrows, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/7d4040cf3e5aae5aca1b44fce4dbc8da7fd7635b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted tree collisions to match leaves better[/p][/*][*][p]Can now limit throttle and steering with epa adjustments (now able go below 1)[/p][/*][*][p]Small tweaks to lighting, color correction, and textures to make the graphics more dynamic[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed rate menu share code not getting creators name[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lists not fully scrolling with controller in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ghost name tags not rotating correctly when ghost wasnt playing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bad rotations on the first frame of ghost replay[/p][/*][*][p]Input preview now accurately shows Expo settings[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
[b]Physics Improvements:[/b]
-Fixed unwanted roll-over behavior introduced in the last update

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

notes.title: Huge physics improvement update and more!
notes.content: [p]Physics Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Significant improvements have been made to tire collision systems, drastically improving handling, stability, and friction on bumpy surfaces where the vehicles used to skip along the ground before[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/bc0e6785f8ea560a150a143c06dd92927dc3922a.gif"][/img][/p][p]New Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added a fancy new news menu to keep up with game updates[/p][/*][*][p]Online track selection now remembers last used category[/p][/*][*][p]Created tracks can now be copied, copied tracks can be uploaded again as long as they are edited first and given a new name[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/8cedcc5e62e3c52cc75356b60c29934237538255.png"][/img][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed multiplying tire forces when objects perfectly overlap each other[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed object holograms in editor occasionally becoming invisible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect error text in track editor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed campaign tracks showing up in recently played list online[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Quick patch fix
notes.content: Quick patch fix for new HB24 bodies causing replays to break. Campaign unlock bodies will no longer cause problems!

notes.title: New campaign, campaign mode adjustments, and more!
notes.content: [p]Campaign Changes:[/p][p]-Rewards are now given for achieving all gold trophies rather than HV trophies[/p][p]-Gold times for the first campaign have all been overhauled to be a bit more friendly[/p][p]-If you already achieved all golds in the first campaign the reward will have been added to your inventory[/p][p][/p][p]New Campaign![/p][p]-A new campaign has been added with 10 new tracks, 40 new trophies, and an all new reward to earn for getting all golds![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/0c94257468a49f295eae01ebb6a4e1f85b0082f0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]-Input binds reset correctly when starting setup wizard[/p][p]-Fixed base feature height control not being available when it should be sometimes[/p][p]-Fixed copying dips not copying height correctly[/p]

notes.title: Transmitter reset channel support, campaign rewards, and more!
notes.content: [p]New Features:[/p][p]-Added ability to bind a transmitter channel to reset the car, no more needing to take your hands of the transmitter to keep racing![/p][p]-New campaign reward system. The High Voltage trophies are hard to get, and you should be rewarded for it![/p][p]-Added reward for first campaign. if you already beat all HV trophies in the first campaign check your HB24 customization parts![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/5b561ac767d8eded117158dacb4c6f2aeb685738.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]-Fixed possibility of saves being overwritten if Steam cloud doesnt sync correctly between devices[/p][p]-Fixed wrong names being shown on campaign track quick race leaderboards[/p][p]-Fixed leaderboards no longer loading correctly in some specific scenarios[/p][p]-Fixed birdseye camera getting all cattywampus when using session marker respawn[/p][p]-Reworked tag and filter dropdown menus in level select[/p]

notes.title: Transmitter compatibility updates, new features, and some QOL changes!
notes.content: [p]New Features:[/p][list][*][p]New feature profiles were added to the track creator[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45480941/b078bd6f95950f923410b39469ea8adf49d7e793.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added Inverse axis centers option to control settings, this should fix issues with various transmitters/adapters that are stuck at 1 after setup. notes.title: Thank you all for an incredible Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]The Next Fest Demo event has now come to end. The demo will no longer be accessible for the time being as I take some time to make tons of improvements and adjustments to the game based on everyone's feedback and the get the game ready for its early access launch coming very soon.

I want to extend a huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone, you all really made this event special and I'm so grateful for everyone that played my game. The response to the demo has been overwhelming in the best way possible and I cant wait for you all to experience whats in store for the full version!

And don't worry, ReCharge RC: High Voltage will be back before you know it, I am planning to launch into early access just next month! I will also be doing some playtesting even sooner than that to make sure everything goes as smooth as possible for the launch of early access, so stay tuned if you want to be involved!

If you created tracks and liveries in the demo do not worry, all of your demo creations will transfer over to the full game! This includes your local tracks and liveries as well as every single uploaded track and leaderboard entry.

Want to keep up to date with what im working on and the changes that will be coming to the full version? Join the official discord server where I post frequent development updates and am active every single day! - [url="https://discord.com/invite/XSdudfWjga"]https://discord.com/invite/XSdudfWjga[/url]

Heres some fun stats about how the demo went:[/p][p]Total downloads of the demo: 14,241[/p][p]Average time played per user: 1 hour 36 minutes[/p][p]Average daily players: 1,299[/p][p]Total leaderboard entries: 49,537[/p][p]Total user created tracks uploaded: 1,093[/p][p][/p][p]Heres a peak at some of the improvements that will be in the early access release, and loads more are coming before early access begins![/p][p][b]Physics Changes:[/b][/p][p]-Removed gyro setting from options (may return after more physics adjustments)[/p][p]-Added improved gyro algorithms making for drastically better slow speed handling[/p][p]-Various vehicle setup adjustments to improve base handling and increase slow speed turning radius[/p][p]-Fixed steering wiggle on fast straights (largely in the HB24 but also in other vehicles)[/p][p]-Very slight changes to HB44 and Thrasher stats to make the Thrasher more competitive on short tracks[/p][p][b]Input System:[/b][/p][p]-Fixed issues preventing some devices from being detecting by input wizard[/p][p]-Added support for single axis input paths (like the arduino and other transmitter adapters use)[/p][p]-Improved input wizard input recognition[/p][p]-Added end point adjustment for throttle and steering[/p][p]-Added automatic detection and setting of end points and input reversing to input setup wizard[/p][p]-Improved input settings menu[/p][p][b]Music:[/b][/p][p]-Created new lo-fi variant of the menu/them song for use in the paint booth and level editor, gives some nice calm background music while you spend time in the editors.[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Fixed incorrect check marks on lap times board[/p][p]-Fixed track editor spawn location display showing when its not supposed to[/p][p]-Removed audio from path warning message in track editor[/p][p]-Fixed controller navigation of input settings menu[/p][p]-Fixed track edge generator not optimizing straight edges correctly[/p][p]-Fixed track edges sticking out into track on sharp corners[/p][p]-Improved track edge graphics[/p][p]-Fixed being unable to click things in the editor if they were too far away[/p][p][b]Race Tracking Changes:[/b][/p][p]-Off track detection improved (can no longer go outside of barriers without off track warning)[/p][p]-Tracks without barriers have wider off track detection that represent the visible track width[/p][p]-Off track detection is less sensitive while jumping, making corner jumps possible[/p][p]-Improved start line detection in specific situations that would cause it to not start the time[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #2!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][b]UI and Navigation Improvements:[/b][/p][p]-Enter track code box highlights when selected[/p][p]-Fixed leaderboard navigation bug causing controller to lose focus, improved load more behavior[/p][p]-Fixed scrolling list with mouse wheel zooming camera in and out[/p][p]-Back button on controller will now exit drop down menus rather than going back[/p][p]-Improved meaning of point to point/circuit option in track editor[/p][p]-Improved contrast on path editor screen[/p][p]-Fix for weird mouse interaction with drop down menus[/p][p]-Fixed not being able to change settings correctly with controller in options menu[/p][p]-Added ability to exit pause menu with back button[/p][p]-Added button to reset remapped controls back to default[/p][p]-Added share track button to rate menu when leaving a track[/p][p]-Pressing left from track select now auto selects the play button[/p][p]-Pressing left or right on any leaderboard entry will select play/back[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p]-Fix for potential doubled steering inputs from keyboard+controller[/p][p]-Fixed exiting game while resetting to track causing physics to be permanently paused[/p][p]-Fixed mouse cursor getting locked out if you switched to mouse during a load transition[/p][p]-Removed joystick (non-standard controller) input from ui so mouse doesnt get locked out when using a joystick (like an rc transmitter)[/p][p]-Fixed game sounds playing while paused if you changed options[/p][p]-Fixed black bars showing for some people on scrolling menus[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][p]-Added "My Tracks" and "Developer Tracks" options to online track select[/p][p]-Added blob shadow under cars when real-time shadows are disabled[/p][p]-Added ability to change selected vehicle from pause menu while racing[/p][p]-Added ability to earn coins for completing laps[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[p]Demo update just released!
-Fixed bug with timer sometimes not starting[/p][p]
-Tweaked track width tracking to not allow cutting on some tracks[/p][p]
-Fixed leaderboards showing wrong numbers when loading more[/p][p]
-Tweaked track edge friction so its not so punishing[/p][p]
-Fixed monitor hz showing decimals[/p][p]
-Tweaked low speed vehicle physics to allow slightly tighter turns (still needs more work but i didnt want to make huge changes that could mess up the leaderboards)

-Few other minor UI and bug fixes[/p][p]
-Added a track share code system. You can now click the share button and a track share code will be copied to your clipboard, this can then be pasted in the box in game to directly download a track.[/p]
